notes.title: Women’s Day Steam Sale 2025
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44923885/c36771053f71d88784e23b9c5583eca8d4c4add3.png

From February 28th - March 9th, our cozy fantasy journal Embers can be found in the 2025 Women’s Day Steam Sale! Congratulations to the organizers for an amazing event and thank you so much for all the work you do!

Three awesome showcases will be shining a spotlight on the amazing games partaking in the Women’s Day Sale! Each showcase will direct their viewers to the sale page throughout the week.


 Games With Wings Showcase - Airing Monday March 3rd at 11am PT / 2pm ET / 7pm GMT / 8pm CET on IGNs YouTube

 Dame 4 Games Showcase - Airing Wednesday March 5th at 12pm PT / 3pm ET

 Women-led-games Showcase - Airing Thursday March 6th at 4pm PT/ 7pm ET


You can find Embers among these fantastic games here on the event page.

#WomensDaySale
